summary: Frontend-only QA for BUG-527 (CPP + PmsCheckoutDrawer fixes) and 2 NEW unfixed issues (DashboardPage tile + CartPanel balance). All 4 BUG-527 scenarios PASS. Both NEW ISSUES confirmed FAIL as expected by main agent.

ui_bugs.issue: NEW ISSUE 1: r4 tile shows pre-discount total ₹1,827 instead of post-discount ~₹827. Root cause: DashboardPage.jsx L48-57 computeRoomCardAmount uses raw remainingRoomBalance without subtracting discountAmount. Fix needed: add `- (order?.roomInfo?.discountAmount || 0)` in the roomBal calculation.

NEW ISSUE 2: data-testid=cart-room-balance shows ₹1,600 instead of ₹600. Root cause: CartPanel.jsx L457-463 roomBalance useMemo does NOT subtract discountAmount (line 459 uses null ?? ... with no discount offset). Fix needed: subtract (roomInfo.discountAmount || 0) from remainingRoomBalance, mirroring CPP L200 fix.

action_items: Fix DashboardPage.jsx L53-55: subtract discountAmount in computeRoomCardAmount → roomBal = Math.max(0, remainingRoomBalance - (order?.roomInfo?.discountAmount || 0))
Fix CartPanel.jsx L457-463: roomBalance useMemo should subtract (roomInfo.discountAmount || 0) from remainingRoomBalance, same pattern as CPP L200
critical_code_review_comments: CartPanel.jsx L459 has `null ??` which is dead code — always evaluates to roomPaymentSummary?.remainingRoomBalance. Clean this up when adding discountAmount fix.
DashboardPage.jsx computeRoomCardAmount comment mentions 'without discount sensitivity' intentionally but this is now incorrect per BUG-527 requirement.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BUG-527 E1-E4 all PASS (CPP shows ₹600, discount line visible, split Cash=200+UPI=48 → Remaining ₹0 → Checkout ₹848 green). Two NEW unfixed issues confirmed: (1) Dashboard r4 tile ₹1,827, (2) cart-room-balance ₹1,600. These need fixes in DashboardPage.jsx and CartPanel.jsx.

rca.new_issue_1: DashboardPage.jsx computeRoomCardAmount L53-55 reads roomPaymentSummary.remainingRoomBalance (pre-discount from backend) and adds it directly to food total. discountAmount is never subtracted. The fix in CollectPaymentPanel L200 was not replicated here.
rca.new_issue_2: CartPanel.jsx L457-463 roomBalance useMemo uses raw remainingRoomBalance without discountAmount offset, same gap as CPP had before BUG-527 fix. The CartPanel roomBalance feeds both the cart display (data-testid=cart-room-balance) and the Checkout button amount.
